# t22.4 — Re-scan Dependencies After PHP 8.2 Compatibility Changes

## Result

The current Composer and npm dependency sets are clear of known advisories. No remediation or dependency upgrade was needed. PHP 8.2 and Laravel 12 remain the declared targets; no dependency manifests or lockfiles were changed by this task.

## Scan Scope

- `composer.json` + `composer.lock`: Composer audit covered 123 locked package records (87 production and 36 development).
- `package.json` + `package-lock.json`: npm audit covered the complete 198-package lock graph (including 53 optional packages).
- Shared `appmod-cve-assessment` npm scan covered all 10 direct declared npm dependencies; full transitive coverage is provided by the lockfile-wide `npm audit`.
- The four root dependency files above are the tracked Composer/npm manifests and lockfiles for this repository.

## Advisory Findings

- Composer: 0 advisories (`composer audit --locked` returned `advisories: []`).
- npm: 0 vulnerabilities across 198 locked packages (0 info, low, moderate, high, or critical).
- Shared assessment: no known CVE vulnerabilities in the 10 direct npm dependencies.
- No new advisory was found; therefore no CVE remediation was required.

Reports:
- [Composer locked audit](./composer-audit-report-3.json)
- [npm full-lock audit](./npm-audit-report-3.json)
- [Shared assessment scan](./cve-report-3.json)

## Target and Lock Validation

- `composer.json` still requires PHP `^8.2` and Laravel `^12.0`.
- `composer.lock` resolves `laravel/framework` to `v12.72.0` and records PHP `^8.2`.
- Runtime used for validation: PHP 8.2.12.
- Composer lock platform check passed; the install dry-run confirmed the locked set is installable on this platform.
- `git diff --check` passed for the four dependency files.

## Changed Files

- Dependency manifests/lockfiles changed by t22.4: none.
- New task evidence: `composer-audit-report-3.json`, `npm-audit-report-3.json`, and the shared-tool `cve-report-3.json`.
- At task start, `git status` already showed `composer.json`, `composer.lock`, `package.json`, and `package-lock.json` as modified. Their existing working-tree changes were preserved; no source dependency changes were made by this task.

## Test Results

- Commands: `composer audit --locked --format=json --no-interaction --no-plugins`; `npm audit --package-lock-only --json --ignore-scripts`; shared `appmod-cve-assessment` over 10 direct npm dependencies; `composer check-platform-reqs --lock --no-interaction --no-plugins`; `composer install --dry-run --no-scripts --no-plugins --no-interaction --no-progress`; `git diff --check -- composer.json composer.lock package.json package-lock.json`.
- Passed: 6 scan/validation checks.
- Failed: 0.
- Skipped: application test/build suite (not run, to avoid application bootstrapping and any `.env` processing).
- Composer commands disabled plugins; the install dry-run also disabled scripts. No application bootstrap or database/migration operation was run.

## Constraints Observed

No `.env` file was inspected, read, printed, searched, copied, uploaded, or otherwise processed. No database access/migrations, deployment, router or infrastructure operation, or commit was performed. No unrelated dependency upgrade was made.
